Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low O₂ saturation, low pO₂), normocytic anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with marked neutropenia and lymphopenia, and elevated basophils. Creatinine is mildly elevated, suggesting possible renal impairment. Total protein is slightly low. Findings are consistent with acute respiratory failure and possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
